scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, every canonical BibTeX entry, the complete publication source-file set, the active user-library selection, and the citation dependency closure were checked; no priority or formal open-problem-status claim is audited because the manuscript makes none.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage audit: first freeze each substantive claim, precise manuscript or bibliography location, and direct key in the schema-version-1 claim ledger; then independently replay each locator against the primary publisher or arXiv passage, reconcile body, BibTeX, AUX, and ledger key sets, and run the hook-compatible user-library selection validator.
